comparator.sourceNotes: The selected Jewish Studies and Hebrew catalogue allocation totals 60+60+60, but it is diagnostic rather than a certified coherent route. Compulsory abroad course 126221008Y requires Tekst, mens, God: geselecteerde Rabbijnse teksten, which is absent from the selected pathway; no placement, equivalence, waiver or authorized alternative is published. Official sources also conflict on Israel versus Prague/London/current Prague-if-possible hosting, while the Ulpan C1 title conflicts with B2 learning outcomes. Diagnostic test and tutoring are zero-credit formation. Known Dutch, Hebrew and English instruction metadata is corrected independently of the unresolved pathway.

routeSelection.basis: The UvA presents two majors after the shared first year. Select the first-listed Jewish Studies and Hebrew major, which develops the degree’s Hebrew-language and Jewish-studies identity, under the official-order tie break. The Middle Eastern Studies major is a separate, broader route and is not used to make a more convenient UCR comparison.
